_description: Tracks improvement scores across automated cycles. Each cycle adds an entry with dimension scores (0-100).

cycles.root_cause: Group-scope clarification fired for 'nations/economies' markers; semantic ambiguity blocked multi-country region queries with broad terms like 'employment'
cycles.fix_description: 1) Added 'nations', 'nation', 'economies' to explicit group scope markers. 2) Skip semantic ambiguity clarification for region groups, auto-resolve broad concepts to default metric.

cycles.root_cause: Informational queries (queryType=informational) bypassed by two pre-LLM checks: 1) SemanticClarifier caught broad concepts like 'employment' before LLM could classify queryType. 2) LangChain orchestrator handled all queries before LLM parse step.
cycles.fix_description: 1) Added informational bypass patterns to SemanticClarifier.detect() so metadata queries skip semantic ambiguity check. 2) Added _looks_informational() pre-check to bypass orchestrator for probable informational queries. 3) Added 5 new benchmark queries (info-01..04, session-01). 4) Added 4 new unit tests for semantic clarifier bypass.
